note: Runtime interface strings added for the Lesson 06 player (not lesson content). Editable and localizable; the section labels.en.json files supply ui.watch, ui.practice, ui.play, ui.pause, ui.restart, ui.captions, ui.reduced, ui.silent, ui.retry, ui.continue, ui.skip, ui.model, ui.speed, ui.previous and ui.next.

strings.ui.thinkHint: Think first. Watch then shows one authored possibility.
strings.ui.gateHint: Choose below, or skip. There is no timer.
strings.ui.rehearseHint: Take as long as you need. Nothing is recorded.
strings.ui.awaitChoice: Waiting for your choice. Play does not choose for you.
strings.ui.awaitRehearsal: Waiting. Rehearse privately, then show a possible reply, skip, or continue.
strings.ui.branchReady: This authored possibility has finished. Continue, or try again.
strings.ui.modelReady: The possible reply has finished. It is an authored example, not your response.
strings.ui.skipped: Skipped. Nothing was recorded or assessed.
strings.ui.end: End of section. Nothing was recorded or assessed.
strings.ui.modeShared: Both modes share this section's reflection route.
strings.ui.modeReset: Mode changed inside an interaction: returned to its start.
strings.ui.backToGate: Returned to the interaction. The earlier attempt was cleared.
strings.ui.stoppedAtGate: Stopped at the interaction. Choose or skip to continue.
